At L:c=0, T=-u6/u5 restricts to t=b/a; all off-boundary points of generic E satisfying u3=u4=0 force T^m=1, so unique divisorial preimage. On a=1, G=u3/u1 has order m-1 and H=1+d(u1/u5)T^(m-1) has order m; the numerator coefficient is (m-1)t^(m(m-1))(1+t^-m), independently verified symbolically for m=3..9. Coprime valuation orders and residue t give ramification and residue degree one, hence function-field degree one in characteristic zero. Finite birational normal source means normalization. Two hyperplane sections give deg Y=(2m-1)^2; generically rank-1 differential on L gives nonnormal generic E of degree 2m-1. Finite field image enumeration is diagnostic only.
